t: The DEWALT DW0822-XJ Red Self-Levelling Cross-Line Plumb Laser is a compact and lightweight tool for precise alignment and levelling tasks on any job site. This robust laser projects two bright lines and two plumb spots, offering horizontal, vertical, plumb, and reference beams. It is ideal for electricians installing fixtures or tilers ensuring perfect layouts in kitchens and bathrooms. With an impressive 15m working range without a receiver, extending to 50m with one, and an accuracy of ±3.0mm/m, professional results are guaranteed. Its IP54 rating ensures durability for both indoor and outdoor use. The integrated magnetic pivoting base adds convenience, allowing for easy attachment to metal surfaces or tripods. Its ergonomic design not only aids portability but also reduces user fatigue.
b: Integrated Magnetic Pivoting Base with ¼" Thread
